description: sobre los mares metanógenos, la atmosfera es un experimento cientifico y la gravedad es una opción arquitectónica y el silencio, el lujo más costoso.El aire huele a ozono recubierto de vainilla sintética y en las plataformas flotantes de los jardines verticales, los robles transgénicos de hojas plateadas capturan los rayos ultravioleta del sol. No hay polvo, ni hojas,todo se procesa, todo se recicla. Neo-terram es un organismo vivo, perfecto e indomable: monumento de cristal y energía que vibra
summary: Neo-Terram is a conceptual design—combining aerospace engineering and closed-loop biological architecture—intended to orbit or float above Earth’s methanogenic seas, anticipating a future defined by high levels of pollution and arid, hostile atmospheric conditions. The habitat incorporates artificial gravity via centrifugation, a biomimetic life-support system based on transgenic botany, and environmental management governed by an Artificial Superintelligence (ASI), achieving a recycling efficiency of 99.98%.
details:
Gravitational and Acoustic Architecture:

Optional Gravity: The main structure is a toroid made of aluminum oxynitride (ALON) and graphene. It rotates to provide thermal insulation from the external environment, while the central core maintains microgravity—or zero gravity—to facilitate continuous space research and rapid transit. This design utilizes technology developed by NASA for living on Mars.

Silence as a Luxury: Due to the absence of natural convection in zero-gravity zones and the integration of acoustic metamaterials into the structural panels, mechanical noise from life-support systems is neutralized. Absolute silence is a deliberate, zoned design feature.

Methanogenic Seas: Positioned above liquid hydrocarbon lakes (such as Kraken Mare), the system extracts methane (CH₄) and ethane (C₂H₆)—serving as primary sources of carbon and hydrogen—via cryogenic distillation towers.

Ambient Scent: The internal atmosphere consists of a controlled mixture of nitrogen and oxygen. A faint, characteristic ozone scent—a byproduct of the cold-plasma generators used to sterilize the air—is intentionally masked with synthetic vanillin esters to help reduce psychological stress among the experimental crew.

Genetically modified *Quercus* (oak) trees grow on magnetically stabilized floating platforms. Their silvery leaves contain synthetic photosynthetic pigments capable of absorbing high-energy ultraviolet radiation and converting it into biomass and oxygen, while simultaneously shielding the lower levels from cosmic radiation.

There is no dust or accumulation of dead organic matter. Cleaning nanobots and plasma bioreactors break down every particle—from fallen leaves to human waste—at the molecular level. These are then repurposed as mineral nutrients or 3D-printing polymers, which are subsequently integrated into the agricultural systems housed within the domes, utilizing organic-based hydroponics. Use of Superintelligence (ASI - Aether Core).
